blocks.x: Enterprise Copilots & Digital Workplace: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Employees juggle 12 tools and tribal knowledge; generic AI tools leak data; every team builds its own prompts; nothing is measured.
Our approach

We deploy the workplace assistant layer on shared rails: retrieval over your corpus with permissions, task integrations (mail, docs, CRM, ERP), role-scoped policies, and adoption/impact measurement per function.
Components

items: Mail, docs, CRM/ERP actions under policy
What each role can ask and act
Time saved and quality lift per function

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Forge: Many agents operating as one governed, measurable workforce. The governed data estate every AI program needs.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared: 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Industry fit
Deployed across all industries. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
